 For the Petitioner : Mr. Akhilesh Kumar Singh, Advocate
 For the State : Mr. Jitendra Pandey, A.P.P.
 .....

Order No.05/ Dated:16.05.2024
 1.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.

2. Apprehending his arrest in connection with Gumla (Mahila) P.S. Case No. 07 of 2023 instituted under Sections 498A/ 323/ 504/ 506/ 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, the petitioner has moved to this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail.
3. As per prosecution case, informant is a para teacher.
On 04.03.2017, she got married to one Ravi Keshri.

At the time of marriage, false information was given that Ravi Keshri is B.com Pass and Rs.
15,00,000/- (Fifteen Laks) was demanded as dowry.

Somehow father of the informant managed to pay Rs. 10,00,000/- (Ten lacs) and due to non-fulfillment of the rest amount, informant was pressurized to quit her job and was harassed by her husband and her in laws.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that matter was referred to mediation center,
JHALSA with consent of both parties for settlement and settlement has been arrived at between the parties and both the parties have agreed to live together.
Earlier a petition under Section 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act for restitution of conjugal rights has also been filed by the petitioner and in that also both parties agreed to live together.

It is lastly submitted that the petitioner undertakes to co-operate with the investigation of the case and also abide by all terms and conditions which may be imposed in the matter of granting anticipatory bail to the petitioner.
Hence, the petitioner may be extended the privilege of anticipatory bail.
5. Learned Addl.P.P appearing for the State opposes the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner.
6. Learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 has raised no objection in the matter of conciliation between the parties.

sentences.text: Having regard to the facts and circumstances, nature of allegation and also in view of settlement between the parties, I am inclined to grant privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

Accordingly, the petitioner is directed to surrender in the Court below within four weeks from today and in the event of his arrest or surrendering, he will be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate at Gumla in connection with Gumla (Mahila) P.S.
Case No. 07 of 2023 with the condition that he will co-operate with the investigation of the case and appear before the investigating officer as and when noticed by him and furnish his mobile number and photocopy of the Aadhar Card with an undertaking that he will not change his mobile number during the pendency of the case and subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

(Pradeep Kumar Srivastava, J.) R.K/
